title: Tuty
description: Your beauty collection, intelligently organized. A smart inventory system for makeup and skincare.
longDescription: Tuty was born from the need to manage makeup and skincare collections for users who feel they are losing control. It's an intelligent mobile application designed to solve the chaos of duplicate purchases and missed expiration dates. Tuty provides real-time awareness: what you have, what is running out, and what needs to be replaced. It eventually learns user habits to provide more accurate predictions and suggestions, with AI Assistant Lily at the heart of its future vision.
features: Barcode Scanning for automatic product detection

title: Quantum Agent
description: A mobile swipe game about time travel where every decision alters the timeline.
longDescription: Quantum Agent is a narrative-driven decision game designed for mobile. Players swipe left or right on event cards to manage agents and manipulate time. Every choice has lasting effects on agent stats and the stability of the timeline. The game blends branching storytelling with risk management and resource control.

title: Zoo Merge (Temp Name)
description: A zoo-themed Merge-2 mobile game developed entirely through Generative AI-assisted pair programming.
longDescription:
Zoo Merge challenges players to merge resources, manage grid space, and fulfill specific animal orders to build and expand their habitats. Designed with a rapid-prototyping mindset, the primary mission of this MVP is to deliver a fully playable, polished experience to gather real-world user feedback, demonstrating the power of LLM-driven game development in creating robust game economies and addictive core loops. 

**Performance Note:** This project serves as a case study in Advanced Agentic Coding. By collaborating with a customized Generative AI agent, I accelerated the development lifecycle from system architecture to UI implementation. Complex systems like contextual UI rendering, nested layout groups, and scalable ScriptableObject databases were iterated upon in real-time, proving that AI pair-programming is not just for boilerplate code, but for architecting fully-fledged, production-ready game systems.
systems: Modular codebase with C# partial classes
